residual.statement: Not guaranteed by this pass: corruption of two or more characters; a whole swap for another digest; and any token whose digest is not one of the file's own registered arguments.

digestPolicy: No act argument or truncated digest is quoted (AGENTS.md: CG-7e/CG-15 copy rule). Each mutant is re-runnable from its selector, tokenStartColumn, characterIndexInToken and fromChar/toChar; checker output has every 12-64 character hex run replaced by <digest>. restoreSha256 is the restored file's own hash, not an act argument.
